ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines a and b are intersected by lines c and d. If $a\parallel b$ and $\angle 1=120^\circ$, $\angle 2=30^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle 3$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure,\\
$\because a \parallel b$,\\
$\therefore \angle 4 = \angle 1 = 120^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle 4 = \angle 2 + \angle 3$,\\
$\therefore \angle 3 = \angle 4 - \angle 2 = 120^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{90^\circ}$.
